faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.free.question: Is TypeWhisper really free?
faq.free.answer: Yes. The core app is free and open source under GPLv3, including internal use at work. A Commercial license adds Premium features, non-GPL terms, and support.
faq.privacy.question: Does my voice leave my device?
faq.privacy.answer: Not with local engines: speech is processed on your Mac, PC, iPhone, or iPad. Cloud speech and AI providers are only used after you configure and select them.
faq.platforms.question: Which platforms are supported?
faq.platforms.answer: macOS 14 or later (version {macVersion}), Windows 10 and 11 (version {windowsVersion}), and iPhone and iPad with iOS 18 or later (version {iosVersion}), including an Apple Watch app. Each edition is built natively for its platform.
faq.languages.question: Which languages does TypeWhisper understand?
faq.languages.answer: That depends on the engine. Whisper-based engines recognize about 100 languages, Parakeet focuses on 25 European languages, and cloud providers add more. You can switch engines at any time.
faq.work.question: Can I use TypeWhisper at work?
faq.work.answer: Yes. The GPL app may be used internally in companies. For non-GPL terms, support, and managed rollouts, Commercial licenses are available for individuals and teams.
faq.builtIn.question: How is it different from built-in dictation?
faq.builtIn.answer: Built-in dictation types what you say. TypeWhisper lets you choose the engine, cleans up and formats text with workflows, applies rules per app, transcribes files, and keeps a searchable history.
